text: Different feeding systems produce very different growth rates (measured as ADG from about 30 kg to slaughter at about 80 kg), all else being equal: commercial feed gives around 700 g/day ADG; a traditional home-made feed (kitchen waste + cooked rice + rice bran) gives only around 300 g/day; adding 10% fish meal to the home-made feed raises this to around 450 g/day; adding a basemix (vitamins, minerals, and the amino acid lysine) to the home-made feed raises it further to around 600 g/day. Under the same conditions and breed, a better-balanced diet consistently means faster growth, and better feeding gives the biggest payoff when raising crossbred pigs kept in good health. Pigs should also be de-wormed regularly regardless of feeding system.
